run_rate_limiter: run the rate limiter script with a specified MB/s rate to throttle stdin to stdout
review_rate_limiter_logic: review the rate limiter script that reads stdin and writes stdout at a controlled rate
test_rate_limiter_cli: test the rate limiter CLI by piping data through it with a given MB/s argument
refactor_rate_limiter_units: refactor the rate limiter to accept rate units beyond MB/s such as KB/s or GB/s
summarize_rate_limiter: summarize the rate limiter script that acts as a replacement for pv with no catch-up behavior
